title: SEO Meta Output
description: Output of meta-builder skill. Stored at memory/workspace/{task_id}/meta.json. Field names match WordPress + RankMath REST endpoints. Audit 2026-05-22 P5 fixes: tags is now array (not comma-string), image_search_keywords no longer required (production omits it), og_image canonicalized (was og_image_url), twitter_card_type canonicalized (was twitter_card).

title.description: Article title (becomes <h1> + WordPress post title). Loosened from 50-65 char range per audit 2026-05-22 — 30-120 reflects the production range across all 24 templates.

seo_title.description: RankMath rank_math_title (+ og:title). The short indexed <title>; differs from the longer `title`/H1. Target 51-60 chars (hard cap 65). 2026-06-16: MUST share the entity + primary keyword + every number present in `title` (Google preserves a number in the displayed title 97.3% only when it is in BOTH). No (year) suffix here — year belongs in `title`. Validated by scripts/validate/title_validator.py.

register.description: Title register (2026-06-16). Gates the title rules: power-word policy, digit policy, banned terms. Resolved from business-context.json :: voice_default (title_validator.infer_register), with per-article override for dtc_grief vs dtc_celebration.

slug.description: Kebab-case URL slug. Should contain primary_keyword tokens.

excerpt.description: Meta description / RankMath rank_math_description. 50-160 ideal for SERP; loosened upper bound to 320 because production sometimes uses the excerpt field for longer summaries.

meta_description.description: Alias of excerpt for backward compatibility with older meta-builder output. Publisher reads excerpt if meta_description is absent.

robots.description: RankMath rank_math_robots. NEVER include 'follow' — invalid enum that 400s the entire POST. Use ['index']; follow is the implicit default.

advanced_robots.description: RankMath rank_math_advanced_robots — e.g. max-image-preview, max-snippet, max-video-preview

tags.description: Tag names (canonical: array of strings). Legacy comma-separated string also accepted for back-compat — publisher's wp_taxonomy.get_or_create_terms() handles both. Audit 2026-05-22 P5 fixed: production uniformly writes array.

image_search_keywords.description: Optional. Keywords for image alt + filename generation. Audit 2026-05-22 P5: removed from required list because production runs (image_prompts.json owns this) consistently omit it.

schema_jsonld.description: Custom JSON-LD @graph payload (most plugins inject via head; per-post supplementals live in schema.json instead)

og_image.description: Open Graph image URL. CANONICAL field name. Publisher reads og_image; og_image_url accepted as alias for legacy back-compat.

og_image_url.description: Alias of og_image for legacy back-compat. New emitters should use og_image.

twitter_card_type.description: Twitter card type. CANONICAL field name. twitter_card accepted as alias for legacy back-compat.

twitter_card.description: Alias of twitter_card_type for legacy back-compat.
